description: This source file defines an enumeration `GatewayConnectChallengeSupport` with static utility methods related to handling nonce values and asynchronous waiting with timeout, used in the context of gateway connection challenges.

methods.name: nonce(from:)
methods.description: Extracts and trims the 'nonce' string from a payload dictionary if present.

methods.name: waitForNonce(timeoutSeconds:onTimeout:receiveNonce:)
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a nonce value within a timeout period, calling `receiveNonce` repeatedly until it returns a non-nil value or timeout occurs.
